acip: MA KHYAB NA KHYAB PA YOD PAR THAL, DKAR PO DANG NAG PO GNYIS KYI GZHI MTHUN MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal, dkar po dang nag po gnyis kyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir
english: Just because something is black doesn't mean that it can't be white. And yet it does mean that; because there is no one thing which is entirely white and entirely black, at the same time!
